in_sanskrit.name: इलेना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ileana can be derived from the Sanskrit words 'il', meaning 'shining' or 'bright', and 'ana', meaning 'radiant' or 'flowing'. This name evokes images of a brilliant, shining star or a radiant, flowing river.
